status: Implementation preparation; not compiled or activated
evidence_limits: Upstream is an independent reconstruction, not Ascension's official backend.
Local PTR module source supplements the incomplete public implementation overlays.
Installed overlay hashes are not evidence of latest upstream client release. Discord release identity and full upstream manifest remain unavailable.
No new combined-system runtime tests have run. Previously verified PTR behavior is not Area 52 verification.

architecture.primary: Upstream native Pet, PetStable and AscensionTaming own capture, family calls, saved pets and purchased stable slots.
architecture.secondary: Retain More Minions optional independent guardian, including Demon and Beckon Beast paths. Never allocate a native primary/stable slot to it.
architecture.progression: Area 52 advancement catalog and learned server spells authorize access; do not copy PTR AP prices, synthetic purchase IDs or Wildcard rolls.
architecture.isolation: Independent Area 52 secondary feature switch, disabled outside the authorized Free Pick mode. Disabling suspends the secondary without deleting ownership records.

decisions.choice: Adopt pet portions of upstream PRs 6380, 6161 and 6407 with dependencies reviewed individually.
decisions.reason: Native family IDs, DBC skill lines, starter pets and captured-versus-summoned separation better match Ascension client data than copying PTR family substitutions.

decisions.choice: Do not transplant More Minions reserved slots 101-105 or its competing PrimaryController.
decisions.reason: PTR reserves one primary per creature kind; upstream uses paid native stable slots. Running both would produce incompatible slot ownership. No PTR pet records are being migrated.

decisions.choice: Carry More Minions plan-before-mutation and commit-confirmation lessons into focused upstream regression review.
decisions.reason: Upstream CheckCast calls StableUnslottedHunterPets before MakePlan and performs swaps/starter creation in CheckCast. Verify later cast failure, starter creation failure, repeated checks and database failures do not leave unintended state. These are review risks, not reproduced defects.

decisions.choice: Retain separate ownership, health/resource state, cooldowns, autocast, reactions, controls, strain and fatigue.
decisions.reason: This intentionally extends upstream's single primary pet. Keep one secondary total, with native target/resource/cooldown validation and owner-scoped control.

decisions.choice: Split Demon and Beckon entitlements before porting.
decisions.reason: Current MoreDemons::Access requires synthetic Demon Mastery authorization for both paths. Beckon additionally checks custom spell 920000 and talent 34454; Demon checks 920007 and talent 18710 at level 35. Resolve effective Area 52 ranks and catalog links rather than assuming these IDs express equivalent progression.

decisions.choice: Retain reviewed More Minions audience distinctions and shared-budget safeguards where native handlers do not cover the secondary.
decisions.reason: Distinguish summoned demon, captured demon, beast and general minion targets; do not apply both native and module scaling/procs to one actor. Revalidate ImportedEffectAudiences against current effective spell data.

decisions.choice: Compare neutral-target eligibility, completed-channel ownership, target validity, long names and captured size against upstream before adding patches.
decisions.reason: More Minions contains dedicated handling, but source presence alone does not establish superiority over current upstream.

decisions.choice: Prefer native Ascension stable UI. Port only required secondary controls and verified missing spell definitions.
decisions.reason: PTR Classic stable compatibility shims and custom spell range 919990-920007 require collision, shape and icon checks; do not distribute them wholesale.

implementation_sequence: Prepare focused CoA fork branch from the reconciled Area 52 integration source; preserve early-login, data-path, terrain, advancement and builder changes.
Integrate native primary pet changes and shared Hero eligibility without Wildcard progression or CoA class-specific changes.
Audit effective Spell/CreatureFamily/SkillLineAbility data and SQL families; validate every secondary prerequisite and custom ID before authorizing or granting it.
Port optional secondary controller separately, remove native-demon auto-adoption unless explicitly routed by verified secondary entitlement, and keep primary pet save/load untouched.
Add additive secondary storage migrations and client control adapter; preserve rollback compatibility and do not import PTR characters.
Review pet effect audiences, scaling and proc budgets; port only demonstrated gaps.
Run focused verification through CoA verify_all, compile, then stage paired client/server candidate with backup and gameplay checklist.
acceptance: Beast, Undead, Demon, Elemental and Dragonkin: capture, starter, recall, dismiss, death/revive, stable, purchased/full slots, relog and restart.
Primary plus secondary: independent control, switching each, death, mount, teleport, level-up, logout and restart without replacing or deleting the other.
Secondary Demon and Beast unlock independently through verified Area 52 progression; removing entitlement suspends only the affected secondary.
Interrupted capture, invalid target, cast failure and database failure preserve prior pets and ownership.
Cooldowns, autocast, strain/fatigue and resource drain cannot be reset by relog or replacement; no doubled scaling or proc awards.
Feature disabled, non-Hero, CoA and Wildcard configurations retain intended baseline behavior.
Skull Banner remains outside this pet integration; Bear Cave PTR is unchanged.
